conversations.title: Planning formats for a small team
conversations.user: We're six people on one product. Which planning format should we use, and how do they compare?
conversations.answer:
## Three planning formats for a team of six

With six people on one product, the right format depends on how far ahead you can see and how often priorities move.[1]

**Weekly planning** keeps the queue short and suits work that changes every few days. **Two-week sprints** add a review and a retrospective, which helps when you want a steady rhythm.[2]

**Six-week cycles** with a short cool-down leave room for larger, well-shaped pieces of work.[3]

| Format | Best when | Watch out for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Weekly | priorities move often | planning overhead |
| Two-week sprints | a steady rhythm | sprint padding |
| Six-week cycles | larger shaped work | late feedback |

```ts
const cadence = { weekly: 7, sprint: 14, cycle: 42 };
```
